label: The Aurelia, 1934
summary: A luxury airship crossing the Atlantic in three days, with a ballroom, forty passengers and one cabin that is suddenly empty.

world.setting: The Aurelia, a luxury airship crossing from Southampton to New York
world.description: The Aurelia is the most elegant way to cross the ocean: a ballroom, a smoking room sealed against sparks, a dining room with silver service and promenade windows over the clouds. Forty passengers, sixty crew and three days with nowhere to go but down.
rules: A fair-play mystery: every clue the solution needs is shown to the reader
No one can leave the ship until New York
Every passenger has a secret, and most of them are not murder
1930s manners, money and politics shape what people say
